content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical), 3 for Project Nurse (III) and 1 for Project Technical Support III.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): Post Graduate Degree in life sciences including the integrated PG degrees. Project Nurse(III): Four-year Nursing Course. Project Technical Support III: Three Years Graduate degree in relevant subject/field + three Years post qualification experience or PG in relevant subject/field or Engineering/IT/CS - Four Years Graduate Degree.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Project Research Scientist I (Non-Medical): Rs. 56,000 + 10% HRA = Rs. 61,600 per month Project Nurse(III): Rs. 28,000 + 10% HRA = Rs. 30,800 per month Project Technical Support III: Rs. 28,000 + 10% HRA = Rs. 30,800 per month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 is 15 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.answer: The educational qualification required for the Project Nurse(III) post is a Four-year Nursing Course.

faq.answer: The salary for the Project Technical Support-III post is Rs. 28,000 + 10% HRA, which amounts to Rs. 30,800 per month.

faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.answer: The selection process for the AIIMS Rishikesh Recruitment 2026 includes a Written Exam followed by an Interview.
